about: Calibrated similarity floors (workstream 004 s26), written by umx-bench's floor-calibration (crates/umx-bench/src/bin/floor-calibration/main.rs); umx_core::similarity::CALIBRATED is checked against it. No vectors and no corpus text.

cache.regenerate: floor-calibration --embedder <instance> --cache <cache> --out <dir> --commit <sha> (the floors run fills the cache); without the cache this tool cannot run again, and the committed cuts stay as they are

strength.max_n_note: labels stop (null, and the space does not count toward no_strong_match) when more than 2 x max_n_measured nodes are searched in the space, until a larger corpus is measured (follow-up: a 57k corpus such as FiQA sampled at 20k and 50k)

off_topic_pairs_kept.spot_check: biomedical claims against food-plant, delivery, design and customer questions; the nearest share a word-level theme (allergy, bacteria, vision) but answer another question
8 of 45 past the floor; nearest are cell biology papers on a shared word (migration, thermogenesis, honey bee genomics against a waggle-dance question)
4 of 45 past the floor; nearest share one word (whales and tuna, herding farms and Campylobacter)
debates against operational questions; nearest are unrelated arguments, one food-labelling policy debate against an allergen label review task
scientific claims against the four fixture domains; nearest are design-studio notes matched on a word (fidelity, warm-ups)
3 of 45 past the floor; nearest share one word (workshop, scoring)
0 of 45 past the floor

against_recorded.note: the committed query rows were recorded on 2026-11-11 by another umx build on the same machine and backend

strength.rule: strong: z >= strong_z + strong_z_per_ln * ln N (when z_part) AND cosine >= strong_score; fair: the same with the fair cuts; else weak. z = (cosine - median) / MAD over every searched node's whole-node cosine. The cuts at a quantile level L of the kept off-topic top hits (the best whole-node cosine among nodes past the floor): the z line a least-squares fit on ln N through each (corpus, N) cell's L-quantile, raised over every cell, and the pooled cosine L-quantile; strong the loosest L (0.001 steps from 0.999) at which no cell's off-topic top hits are strong more than strong_rate, fair the loosest at which none are fair or strong more than 1 in 10. MIN_POPULATION: the smallest N from which every larger rung's p90 bootstrap 90% half-width of z is at most half the gap between the strong and fair z cuts at that N.
strength.spot_check: each candidate pair's 20 highest off-topic top hits read side by side (`--spot <file>`, a scratch file never committed: it holds corpus text); kept only when none is on topic

tight.chosen: the documents nearest (whole-node cosine) to the base document with the most neighbours at or above the similar_to floor

strength.tool_at: the PR head that adds or changes this tool (its commit is recorded after merge); umx_commit is the base it was built on, which does not hold the tool

z_settling.caveat: the joint rule's median is 0 in these cells too, because strong is rare by design at the 1-in-100 off-topic rate; the table shows z prevents a flood of strong hits in tight graphs, not that z makes strong common; cosine-only has higher on-topic strong rates and floods tight graphs
